comments.author: AsturiasTV
comments.body:
It’s clear that you put this together very quickly, using an extremely brief, generic prompt and without any prior knowledge. Why rush it and be so careless? You’re more than capable of delivering something 1,000 times better, you know?

For instance, I created something far more complex in PowerShell: a hero shooter in the style of AAA titles. It features 20 game modes, massive multiplayer support for over 100 simultaneous users, 50 maps, advanced weapon customization, and an engine built from scratch—including its own netcode and an in-game store system—all without relying on any external libraries. It even has its own anti-cheat system.

“If you decide to sell it as a shooter and it ends up full of cheaters, you’ll likely be forced to issue refunds.”
